content: Create a Webinar Account Click the App Launcher.  In the Quick Find box, enter and click "Webinar Accounts." Click {{variable.button_new}} . Fill in the following fields. {{variable.Field_WebinarAcct_Provider}} = "Zoom", "GoToWebinar", or "Webex" (required) {{variable.Field_WebinarAcct_WebinarName}} (required) {{variable.Field_WebinarAcct_FirstName}} , {{variable.Field_WebinarAcct_LastName}} , {{variable.Field_WebinarAcct_Email}} , {{variable.Field_WebinarAcct_OrganizerKey}} , and {{variable.Field_WebinarAcct_AccountKey}} will be populated once you connect the account to your provider. Click {{variable.Button_Save}} .  Open the {{variable.Object_WebinarAccount}} record and click Authorize .    Complete the OAuth by clicking {{variable.Button_Connect}} and entering your webinar account credentials.    Your Webinar Account should be automatically updated with the {{variable.Field_WebinarAcct_FirstName}} , {{variable.Field_WebinarAcct_LastName}} , {{variable.Field_WebinarAcct_Email}} , {{variable.Field_WebinarAcct_OrganizerKey}} , and {{variable.Field_WebinarAcct_AccountKey}} . Authentication Error If you receive the following error message when authorizing a Zoom account, please complete the steps below. Error Message: "It looks like you are already authenticated to use the Zoom Integration. If you are receiving other errors, please contact Blackthorn Support." Navigate to: https://marketplace.zoom.us/ . Click Manage. Click Added Apps. Find "Blackthorn Events" and click Remove . Zoom Configurations Events / Zoom Integration Update The following changes have been made to prevent an Attendee from being added to a Zoom meeting or webinar as a cohost. If the integration between Events and Zoom fails to automatically register an Attendee with Zoom, the AttendeeLink will revert to a generic “join” link instead of the link used by the host. Zoom may also require the Attendee to enter their name/register when joining the meeting. Zoom Registration Approval The {{variable.Field_Event_ZoomRegistApprType}} field was added to the {{variable.Object_Event}} object to enforce the approval type as a required value.  Field Label: {{variable.Field_Event_ZoomRegistApprType}} API Name: Zoom_Registration_Approval_Type__c Data Type: Picklist Description: Use this field to define the type of approval a meeting registration requires. The three types of approval are “No registration required” (default setting), “Manually approve registration,” or “Automatically approve registration.” The default setting is “No registration required.” Each approval type uses the following workflow. 0 - Automatically approve registration Attendees can join with their join URL  Users must register for the Meeting/Webinar in advance and will be given the option to join directly after. The host can deny attendees after they have registered. 1 - Manually approve registration Attendees must complete a form before they can join the meeting/webinar. Users must register for the webinar in advance and will only be given options to join after the host approves their registration within the Zoom platform. Note: The Zoom join link is unavailable to {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s until they are manually approved in the Zoom dashboard. Upon approval, {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s will receive a Zoom email. Event Organizers can also manually add the Zoom join link to the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} 's {{variable.Field_Attendee_WebiMeetJoinURL}} field once the link is available.  2 - No registration required Attendees are NOT required to complete a form before joining the meeting/webinar. The {{variable.Field_Event_ZoomRegistApprType}} field is not automatically added to the {{variable.Object_Event}} page layout. To add it, complete the following steps. Click the {{variable.Button_GearIcon}} . Click {{variable.Button_Setup}} . Click Object Manager. In the Quick Find box, enter and click “Event (conference360__Event__c).” Click the Page Layouts tab. Click "Event Layout." Drag and drop the {{variable.Field_Event_ZoomRegistApprType}} field on the page layout. Click {{variable.Button_Save}} . Go to an {{variable.Object_Event}} record. Click the {{variable.Button_Pencil}} icon next to {{variable.Field_Event_ZoomRegistApprType}} . Select a value. "0 - Automatically approve registration" "1 - Manually approve registration" "2 - No registration required" Click {{variable.Button_Save}} Confirm that the {{variable.Object_Event}} record is linked to the {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} record. If a user selects “Manually approve registration,” the Event Organizer must log in to Zoom and manually approve the new registrants to complete the registration process. Click here to go to Zoom’s documentation to learn more.  Zoom’s Personal Meeting ID (PMI) The {{variable.Object_WebinarAccount}} ’s new {{variable.Field_WebinarAcct_DisabZoomPMI}} (conference360__Disable_Zoom_PMI__c) field allows Event Organizers to disable their Zoom account’s Personal Meeting ID (PMI) when Event registrations are required. If an Event Organizer sets the Webinar Account’s {{variable.Field_WebinarAcct_DisabZoomPMI}} field to “True” (checked) after enabling their Zoom account’s Personal Meeting ID (PMI), registered Attendees will be synced from Events to Zoom for meetings with unique Meeting IDs. The following chart shows how the three variables, {{variable.Object_WebinarAccount}} ’s {{variable.Field_WebinarAcct_DisabZoomPMI}} , Zoom account's PMI, and {{variable.Object_Event}} 's {{variable.Field_Event_ZoomRegistApprType}} , can determine the outcome. Zoom Email Notifications The {{variable.Field_Event_ZoomEmailNotificat}} (conference360__Zoom_Email_Notifications__c) field controls whether Zoom email notifications are sent to registrants for the associated Event or Session. Located on both the Event and Session objects, the field allows users to toggle email notifications using the Zoom Meeting API, ensuring flexibility in communication settings. This field is only available for Zoom meetings/webinars.  Both fields use the following picklist values. Use Zoom Account Settings (default): When selected, do not send a value to the Zoom API (the same as the current functionality). Send Zoom Emails: When selected, send “True” for both the {{variable.Zoom_registrant_confirma_email}} and {{variable.Zoom_registrant_email_notifica}} settings.  Do not send Zoom Emails: When selected, send “False” for both the {{variable.Zoom_registrant_confirma_email}} and {{variable.Zoom_registrant_email_notifica}} settings.  If the value is null (blank), do not send a value to the Zoom API. (the same as the current functionality) Zoom URLs in Calendar Descriptions The {{variable.Field_Event_ZoomURLCalendDescr}} (conference360__ Include_Zoom_URL_In_Calendar_Description__c) field on the {{variable.Object_Event}} object allows Event Organizers to show or hide Zoom links in the invite’s {{variable.Field_ETEvent_CalendarDescript}} field after an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} clicks the Add to Calendar button. When the {{variable.Object_Event}} ’s {{variable.Field_Event_ZoomURLCalendDescr}} field is checked, {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s will see text similar to “To join the meeting directly, click here: [link]” in the Calendar’s description. NOTE: {{variable.Object_Attendee}} who join via the direct Zoom link will NOT have their attendance status updated in Salesforce. Create a Webinar Prerequisite Only use webinar-related fields for Webinar Account integrations. Using fields such as {{variable.Field_ETEvent_WebinarMeetingID}} or {{variable.Field_ETEvent_WebiMeetPassword}} as placeholder fields for Events will cause issues when users try to join the webinar. Update Page Layouts Add the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_WebinMeetingAcct}} and {{variable.Field_ETEvent_WebinarMeetingID}} fields to your {{variable.Object_Event}} OR {{variable.Object_Session}} page layout. This will hold the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_WebinMeetingAcct}} and {{variable.Field_ETEvent_WebinarMeetingID}} for the specific webinar. You can set different accounts on multiple {{variable.Object_Event}} s, depending on who is hosting the {{variable.Object_Event}} ! Optional: Add {{variable.Field_ETEvent_WebiMeetPassword}} if you will be enabling passwords. This field is automatically populated if passwords are required on your Zoom account. Optional: Add {{variable.Field_ETEvent_ZoomType}} if you will be using Zoom to determine between a Webinar and Meeting URL. Here is a video that walks through the steps for adding webinars to {{variable.Object_Session}} s. Add the {{variable.Field_Zoom_PersonalMtgIDEnable}} checkbox field to your {{variable.Object_Event}} OR {{variable.Object_Session}} page layout. If {{variable.Field_Zoom_PersonalMtgIDEnable}} = "True" (checked), and a Zoom account has Personal Meeting ID enabled, the Meeting IDs on the Blackthorn record and the AttendeeLink will match. LIMITATION: There is a known limitation when using Blackthorn Events with Personal Meeting IDs. The Attendees must enter a name before joining the meeting. Add the {{variable.Button_CreateWebinar}} button to your {{variable.Object_Event}} OR {{variable.Object_Session}} page layout. This button will generate the meeting inside of Zoom, GoToWebinar, or Webex and populate the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_WebinarMeetingID}} field. Add the {{variable.Button_Attendee_AddtoWebinar}} button on the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} page layout. This button will add an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} to the webinar if the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} is created manually. Add the {{variable.Field_Attendee_WebiMeetJoinURL}} field on the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} page layout. This field sends the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} the direct URL to join the meeting. Configure the Event and Webinar Create a new {{variable.Object_Event}} and add the   {{variable.Object_WebinarAccount}} you just created to the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_WebinMeetingAcct}} field. Zoom Users Only: Select a value for the {{variable.Field_Event_ZoomRegistApprType}} field. If you leave the field blank or select the wrong value and later modify it in Zoom, the registration number in Zoom will not update as expected. "0 - Automatically approve registration"  "1 - Manually approve registration" "2 - No registration required" Click {{variable.Button_Save}} . Click the {{variable.Button_CreateWebinar}} button. The Webinar ID will populate automatically in the {{variable.Object_Event}} 's {{variable.Field_ETEvent_WebinarMeetingID}} field. This value should not be edited, as changing it will prevent {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s from joining your webinar. If there is an issue, the user who authorized the Blackthorn Events app will receive email notifications for critical failures related to webinar URL generation. Show/Hide the Join Video Stream Button The {{variable.Field_EVSettings_RemURLAttLink}} field is located on the {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} object. This field allows users to show or hide the Join Video Stream button to {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s on their {{variable.AttendeeLink}} page when the value in the {{variable.Object_Event}} ’s {{variable.Field_ETEvent_WebinarMtgURL}} field is removed. Set {{variable.Field_EVSettings_RemURLAttLink}} to “No” or leave it blank if you want the existing behavior to continue.  Set {{variable.Field_EVSettings_RemURLAttLink}} to “Yes” if the value in the {{variable.Object_Event}} ’s {{variable.Field_ETEvent_WebinarMtgURL}} (Webinar_URL__c) field is deleted, and you want the information in the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} ’s {{variable.Field_Attendee_WebiMeetJoinURL}} field ( Join Video Stream button) to be removed. Session Streaming {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s can also join a {{variable.Object_Session}} 's video stream if they register for it. When creating a new {{variable.Object_Session}} , define the {{variable.Object_Session}} 's {{variable.Field_Session_WebinarMtgURL}} field.  NOTE:  If the {{variable.Object_SessionAttendee}} ’s {{variable.Field_SessionAtten_WebMJoinURL}} field is blank, the webapp will use the {{variable.Object_Session}} ’s {{variable.Field_Session_WebinarMtgURL}} , ensuring the {{variable.Object_SessionAttendee}} has the correct access.  The   {{variable.Object_Session}} ’s {{variable.Field_Session_WebinarMtgURL}} field controls whether the Join Video Stream button, which functions as a link to the Zoom meeting, is shown (see below). Once an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} registers for an {{variable.Object_Event}} , they will have the option to register for {{variable.Object_Session}} s. If they register for a {{variable.Object_Session}} with a {{variable.Field_Session_WebinarMtgURL}} attached, they will have the option to join! Update an Event’s Webinar/Meeting Account Change the Webinar Time after Event Creation If you need to change the time of a webinar after the Virtual Event is created, you must manually update the changes in Blackthorn. Virtual Event times are only synced at Event creation. If you need to change an {{variable.Object_Event}} ’s {{variable.Field_Event_WebinarMeetingAcct}} , please make the following changes to the {{variable.Object_Event}} ’ record and update your {{variable.Object_Attendee}} (s) records. This will ensure registered {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s have the new {{variable.Field_Attendee_WebiMeetJoinURL}} . Go to the {{variable.Object_Event}} ’ record. Click the {{variable.Button_Pencil}} icon next to {{variable.Field_Event_WebinarMeetingAcct}} . Select a new {{variable.Object_WebinarAccount}} . Click {{variable.Button_Save}} . Go to the {{variable.Object_WebinarAccount}} record that you added to the {{variable.Object_Event}} . Click Authorize . Go back to the {{variable.Object_Event}} record and click {{variable.Button_CreateWebinar}} . Click {{variable.Button_Events_Update}} . One Attendee Complete the following steps to update the {{variable.Field_Attendee_WebiMeetJoinURL}} field for one registered {{variable.Object_Attendee}} . Go to the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} ’s record. Click the {{variable.Button_Pencil}} icon next to {{variable.Field_Attendee_WebiMeetJoinURL}} . Delete the existing value. Click {{variable.Button_Save}} . Click {{variable.Button_Attendee_AddtoWebinar}} . A Group of Attendees Complete the following steps t o update the {{variable.Field_Attendee_WebiMeetJoinURL}} field for a group of registered {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s.  Go to the {{variable.Tab_ET_BTEventAdmin}} tab. Click the {{variable.Tab_BTETAdmin_BatchJobs}} tab. Click {{variable.Button_RegisterAttendeeWebinar}} . NOTE: This batch job will only run when there is a {{variable.Field_ETEvent_WebinarMeetingID}} on the {{variable.Object_Event}} , and the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} 's {{variable.Field_ETAttendee_RegistrStatus}} = "Registered." That's all there is to it! When an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} views their {{variable.AttendeeLink}} , there will be a button to join the meeting! Register Attendees {{snippet.EV_Webinar_Call_AutoRegAttende}} After {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s complete the checkout process and their {{variable.Field_ETAttendee_RegistrStatus}} = "Registered," they will receive a separate email from the Webinar Account owner with the webinar details. {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s going to Zoom meetings will receive a link for the Zoom meeting in their {{variable.AttendeeLink}} instead of a separate email. For example, a GoToWebinar email looks like this: A Webex {{variable.Object_Event}} invite looks similar to this: Opening Zoom and AttendeeLinks When a user opens their AttendeeLink from their phone, they must open the link from either Safari or Chrome. If they use an email app, the AttendeeLink will open correctly, but Zoom will not. Other Notes When an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} clicks Join Video Stream their {{variable.Field_ETAttendee_AttendStatus}} will be set to {{variable.Picklist_AttendStatus_Attended}} if the stream is available. This is the case for any streaming service. If using Zoom, make sure the password is embedded into your link, otherwise {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s will not be able to join. If there is no password for the meeting, this is not required. Ensure your webinar starts at the same time as the {{variable.Object_Event}} . If the webinar is set for 1 p.m. and the {{variable.Object_Event}} is set for 12 p.m. , {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s won't be able to join the webinar at 12 p.m. {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s can click Join Video Stream 15 minutes before the {{variable.Object_Event}} has starts. If a host has not started the webinar, the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} will see "Meeting not started." If the password is enabled, and no password is embedded in the link, {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s will see "Password wrong" with no prompt to enter.  {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s will see the following for each scenario.  Expired Webinar - The video stream has ended, the Join Video Stream button is grayed out and not clickable.   Upcoming Webinar - The video stream will start on... {date}, with a  Join Video Stream  button.     Ongoing Webinar - The {{variable.Object_Event}} is available as a video stream, with a Join Video Stream button.
